rationale: Price is sitting right at VWAP ($11.99) and has shown a slight stabilization in the last two candles after dipping to $11.94-$11.95, but momentum remains weak with a series of lower closes since entry and the 9-EMA ($12.04) acting as overhead resistance rather than a magnet.
